description: Predict FINAL-Bench LLM capability metrics from published input/output token prices.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are aime, elo, gpqa, hle, ifeval, metacog, and 5 more.
